summary: QXO, Inc. files an 8-K (Item 8.01) updating on its pending acquisition of TopBuild Corp. via a two-step merger structure. On April 18, 2026, QXO entered into a merger agreement under which a wholly owned subsidiary (Titanium MergerCo) first merges into TopBuild, making it a QXO subsidiary, followed by a forward merger into another QXO subsidiary. A registration statement and joint proxy/prospectus were filed and declared effective in late May. A stockholder lawsuit (Thompson v. QXO) challenges alleged inadequate disclosures, seeking an injunction; the special meetings are scheduled for June 29, 2026. Terms (price, consideration) are not detailed in this filing. Risk-arb angle: watch the injunction ruling and stockholder vote outcome.
